comment: The quote is exact and stops before the cross-reference. Finding type is right (the reform is not named). The theme_doubtful flag is justified: this is intelligence-service interception powers, close to the cybercrime and law-enforcement exclusion, so it is probably out of scope at G5.
The quote is exact and the summary is faithful. The theme doubt is as for -0056; probably out of scope.

Three sentences on one claim of one type (provider retention obligations); the quote is exact. The note calls these obligations "under the cybercrime law", which the quoted text does not say. The theme doubt is justified.

The quote keeps the list number "5." and so does not start at the claim's first word. It joins a digital ask (participation modules on LPA webpages) with a non-digital one (District Participation Councils) of the same type; acceptable, but the second half is outside the theme. The flag is justified.
Exact quote; finding type right. NCTS is a connection to an EU transit system, so the theme_doubtful flag is appropriately raised under R22.
The quote starts at "reduce", after the arrow and lead-in, as it should. Recommendation type right. The theme doubt is justified (digitalisation is one of three means).

Exact quote. Recorded as an intervention for a named institution, which rules 0.5 (under which this file was extracted) allowed. Under M2 in rules 0.6, a statement of what an institution does would be a finding; no re-extraction is required.
Exact quote ("I t" spacing as converted). Recommendation type and flag are right.
Exact quote; finding type right. Participation in TRACES is use of an EU electronic system within the veterinary sector, so the doubt flag is justified.

Typed intervention (proposed), but the sentence is a Commission Growth Plan statement of what "can be" done; recommendation (EU expectation) fits better and is not flagged ambiguous_type. The quote also mixes Common Transit Convention accession (customs, outside the theme) with TRACES use. Quote and summary are otherwise fine.

Exact quote; recommendation type and flag right. The summary adds "asset" ("automated asset verification systems"), which comes from the preceding sentence, not the quote. Small addition, accurate in context.
Exact quote; intervention, implemented ("launching"); summary faithful. The theme doubt is justified (a public reporting channel inside a labour inspection reform).
Exact quote; two launches of the same type in one sentence, kept as one item. The event date is the platform launch. The theme doubt is justified.

Exact quote; barrier type right (what implementation will require, and resistance). The hedged flag fits "potential resistance". The speaker as Government is consistent with how the Reform Agenda is treated elsewhere.
Exact quote, starting at the claim. Recommendation type right. The theme doubt is reasonable (accessibility; the audiovisual part is outside the theme, as noted).
Exact quote; recommendation type right. Doubtful as a back-office sector system under R22, as noted.
Exact quote. The opening of clusters is not a national measure, so intervention is debatable, but the item carries ambiguous_type. Event date 2026-10 matches cluster 2 (the in-scope cluster).
Exact quote; intervention in_progress fits "initial steps to establish the institutional framework". The summary is faithful.

The quote matches, with line-break hyphens joined ("conditions" for "con- ditions"), consistent with the quote-check convention for this file. The outcome concerns the Digital Moldova 2020 strategy (2013 to 2020), mainly before the evidence window, yet out_of_window is not set and no note explains why it is needed.
The quote matches, with line-break hyphens joined. It is a finding reported from the UNDP analysis; speaker and reported_view are right.
The quote keeps the converted "isone" and the possible_misread flag is set; finding type and reported_view are right.
Exact quote. Barrier type fits (lack of coordination leads to technical problems). reported_view is right.
The quote matches (line-break hyphen joined) and stops before the URL. Finding with reported_view (World Bank) is right.

Exact quote from the risk table; barrier type acceptable. The summary's "Risk rated high" comes from other table cells, not the quote. The theme doubt is justified: public-service staffing in general, probably out of scope.
Exact quote; finding type right. The translation is slightly condensed but keeps the meaning. The doubt flag is justified (systems governance).
Exact quote (a bullet continuing the lead-in "according to information presented by AGE ... in the reference period"). The metric, reported_view and reference period are supported by the lead-in.
Exact quote (the "implementa rea" split is as converted and flagged). The general audit conclusion is a finding. The doubt flag is justified, as it covers accounting matters too.

Exact quote, but on its own it is too vague to carry a claim ("certain shortcomings in applying those provisions"). The summary supplies the subject (the requirement to coordinate ICT spending with AGE) from page 30, which goes beyond the quote. Better to quote with the example sentence that follows, or keep the summary to the quote.
Exact quote; finding type right. The summary expands SV, AAIJ and SFS correctly (customs, courts administration agency, tax service).
Exact table quote; intervention, adopted (Law 77/2023). The doubt flag is justified (parcel deliveries).
Exact quote. A general statement of a success condition, not drawn from experience, so finding is arguably closer than lesson; it is flagged ambiguous_type, which is the right handling.
Exact quote. A White Book recommendation recorded as the ministry's proposed intervention under M1, flagged ambiguous_type with a clear note. Acceptable.
The quote matches across the page break. A legal obstacle to the EESSI connection is a barrier; speaker MMPS with reported_view is right. The summary is faithful.
Exact quote; implemented, as reported by the Cyber Security Agency (reported_view). The note records the conflict with the narrative on page 680, which is useful.
Exact quote; two list entries of the same type kept as one item. The quote keeps the list numbers "3." and "4." (cosmetic). The theme doubt is justified (electoral e-services).
Exact quote; proposed intervention. The event date (2026, year) is the stated planned completion. The doubt flag is justified.
Exact quote; metric details match. The doubt flag is justified (the component is not wholly digital).
Exact quote; proposed intervention ("va fi introdus"). The doubt flag is justified (alignment with EURODAC rather than connection).
Exact quote; proposed intervention. The quote keeps the list marker "2)" (cosmetic). The doubt flag is justified.
Exact quote; two sentences on one measure; implemented, with event date 10 December 2024 as stated. Tagged as an online service used by businesses; the doubt is justified.

The quote is cut in the middle of a word: stated_text ends "...eficienței procesel", while the source reads "proceselor logistice." without a break. The extraction note says the quote "stops where the page text breaks", which is not true. The translation stops earlier (before "precum și creșterea transparenței...") and so does not match the quote. The quote check passed because the fragment is a substring. Meaning is not changed, but rule 4 is breached and the quote needs re-cutting (end at "autoritățile de control" or at "logistice."), with the translation and note corrected.
Exact quote; status unclear is right and well explained. But the summary says the system "is being established", which reads in a status (in progress) that the note says the text does not support.

Exact quote (starting mid-sentence, as noted); metric with reported_view (CNAS). The reference period "at the time of the consultation" is inferred, but reasonably so. The note flags the 16 against 17 conflict for pass 2.
Exact quote; implemented ("a determinat implementarea"). The summary is faithful. The doubt flag is explained.
Exact table quote; proposed intervention with a planned date of August 2026. The doubt flag is justified (competition instrument, broadband subject).

Exact quote; metric details right. reported_view is set (UNDP assessment), but the speaker is recorded as MDED. The rules say the speaker is the party whose view it is (UNDP), as done for the UNDP items in MDA-GOV-2023-001. The quote keeps the paragraph number "15.".

Exact quote. reported_view is justified (the March 2024 eCommerce report), but the speaker is MDED, not the report. A listed "open challenge" states that a problem exists without saying why, so finding fits better than barrier. The quote keeps the list marker "2)".
Exact quote; two adjacent sentences, flagged ambiguous_type with a note. The summary's "open data portal" is the date.gov.md platform named in the preceding sentence.
Exact quote (spacing as converted); intervention in_practice. The summary names the service from the action row, which is acceptable. The doubt flag is justified.
Exact quote; two sentences, one claim (no beneficiary classifier, so the count cannot be measured); finding type right.

Exact quote; a recommendation by MDED in the consultation synthesis, with reported_view. The summary's "digital nomads" comes from the article context, which is acceptable. The chapter 02 basis (third-country residence for work) is plausible.
Exact quote; two sentences of the same request. Recommendation fits (AGE asks other authorities to act); speaker AGE with reported_view.
Exact quote; a Commission finding quoted by NCPDP, with the speaker as the Commission and reported_view; the note records a possible paraphrase.
Exact quote; recommendation part of the sentence, with the shared-sentence note; the speaker is the Commission, quoted by NCPDP.
Exact quote; metric right. The preceding sentence gives a different figure (3,179 persons trained) and the note does not mention it; worth adding. The doubt flag is justified.
Exact quote (the typo "pin" kept as printed); the metric is right. The doubt flag is explained (staffing capacity as context).
Exact quote (spacing as converted). The recommendation reading is flagged ambiguous_type with a note. The summary is faithful.
Exact quote; proposed intervention ("intends"). The doubt flag is justified.
Exact quote. Lesson fits (the source's own attribution of growth to the tax regime). The doubt flag is justified; probably out of scope (IT industry size).
Exact quote; the ambiguous_type and hedged flags are reasonable. But the summary turns "can accelerate" into a normative "should be implemented", a recommendation framing that is not in the quote.
